fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after arrival and have 2 blank pages for visas and stamping.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses desde la llegada y 2 páginas en blanco para visados y sellos.
entry.quote: To enter China, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and 2 blank pages for visas and stamping.

entry.en: Travel to China for any other reason, such as paid work or study, or for more than 30 days requires a visa obtained before the trip.
entry.es: Viajar a China por otro motivo, como trabajo remunerado o estudios, o por más de 30 días exige un visado obtenido antes del viaje.
entry.quote: If you travel to China for any other reason (this includes paid work, long-term assignments, journalism, or study) or for a stay exceeding 30 days, you must apply for a visa before your trip to China.

entry.en: Since 15 November 2025, foreigners may submit a digital arrival card online before arrival instead of the paper arrival card.
entry.es: Desde el 15 de noviembre de 2025, los extranjeros pueden presentar en línea una tarjeta de llegada digital antes de llegar, en lugar de la tarjeta de papel.
entry.quote: From 15 November 2025, foreigners may submit a digital arrival card online prior to arrival in place of the paper arrival card.

entry.en: You must register your place of residence with the local Public Security Bureau within 24 hours of arrival.
entry.es: Debe registrar su lugar de residencia en la Oficina de Seguridad Pública local en las 24 horas siguientes a su llegada.
entry.quote: You must register your place of residence with the local Public Security Bureau within 24 hours of arrival.

entry.en: You must declare to customs if carrying more than ¥20,000 in Chinese currency or more than US$5,000 in foreign currency in or out of the country.
entry.es: Debe declarar en la aduana si lleva más de 20.000 ¥ en moneda china o más de 5.000 US$ en divisas al entrar o salir del país.
entry.quote: You are required to declare to customs if you are carrying more than ¥20,000 in Chinese currency or more than US$5,000 worth of foreign currency in or out of the country.

safety.en: You should always carry your passport, as police carry out random checks and do not accept printed copies.
safety.es: Debe llevar siempre el pasaporte, ya que la policía realiza controles aleatorios y no acepta copias impresas.
safety.quote: Always carry your passport with you. Police carry out random checks, especially during periods of heightened security and major sporting or political events. They do not accept printed copies.

safety.en: China's authorities have detained foreign nationals who break national security laws.
safety.es: Las autoridades chinas han detenido a extranjeros que infringen las leyes de seguridad nacional.
safety.quote: China’s authorities have detained foreign nationals who break national security laws.

safety.en: Beware of scams in popular tourist areas, such as the 'tea tasting' or 'massage' scam.
safety.es: Tenga cuidado con las estafas en zonas turísticas populares, como la de la «cata de té» o el «masaje».
safety.quote: Beware of scams in popular tourist areas. A common example is the ‘tea tasting’ or ‘massage’ scam.

safety.en: Avoid unmarked or unmetered taxis, as there have been incidents of sexual assault and robbery against foreign nationals.
safety.es: Evite los taxis sin identificar o sin taxímetro, ya que ha habido casos de agresión sexual y robo contra extranjeros.
safety.quote: Avoid travelling in unmarked or unmetered taxis, as there have been incidents of sexual assault and robbery against foreign nationals.

safety.en: Possession, trafficking and manufacture of any illegal drugs, including cannabis, are serious offences in China.
safety.es: La posesión, el tráfico y la fabricación de cualquier droga ilegal, incluido el cannabis, son delitos graves en China.
safety.quote: Possession, trafficking and manufacture of any illegal drugs, including cannabis, are serious offences in China.

safety.en: A permit is required to travel to Tibet and the Tibet Autonomous Region, and you must travel on an organised tour.
safety.es: Se necesita un permiso para viajar al Tíbet y a la Región Autónoma del Tíbet, y hay que viajar en un tour organizado.
safety.quote: You must get a permit to travel to Tibet and the Tibet Autonomous Region (TAR) through a specialist travel agent in China. You must also travel on an organised tour.

health.en: Tap water is generally not safe to drink, and only bottled water should be drunk.
health.es: El agua del grifo generalmente no es segura para beber; solo debe beberse agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water is generally not safe to drink. Only drink bottled water.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of China.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en algunas zonas de China.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of China.

health.en: Healthcare is not free in China and can be very expensive.
health.es: La atención sanitaria no es gratuita en China y puede ser muy cara.
health.quote: Healthcare is not free in China and can be very expensive.

health.en: Dengue is present in Guangdong Province and some other parts of China, mainly during the rainy season from May to November.
health.es: El dengue está presente en la provincia de Guangdong y otras zonas de China, sobre todo en la temporada de lluvias de mayo a noviembre.
health.quote: dengue – present in Guangdong Province and some other parts of China, mainly during the rainy season from May to November

health.en: Certain medicines may not be available in China and you may not be allowed to bring others into the country.
health.es: Es posible que ciertos medicamentos no estén disponibles en China y que no se permita traer otros al país.
health.quote: Certain medicines may not be available and you may be not allowed to bring others into the country.

help.en: Emergency numbers in China are 120 for ambulance, 119 for fire and 110 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en China son el 120 para ambulancia, el 119 para bomberos y el 110 para la policía.

help.en: If your passport is lost or stolen, go to the nearest police station or Public Security Bureau and get a report of the incident.
help.es: Si pierde el pasaporte o se lo roban, acuda a la comisaría o a la Oficina de Seguridad Pública más cercana y obtenga un informe del incidente.
help.quote: If your passport is lost or stolen, go to the nearest police station or Public Security Bureau and get a report of the incident.

getting_in.en: The main international gateways to mainland China are Beijing (PEK and PKX), Shanghai (PVG) and Guangzhou (CAN).
getting_in.es: Las principales puertas de entrada internacionales a China continental son Pekín (PEK y PKX), Shanghái (PVG) y Cantón (CAN).
getting_in.quote: The main international gateways to mainland China are Beijing (PEK IATA & PKX IATA, for all airports BJS IATA), Shanghai (PVG IATA) and Guangzhou (CAN IATA).

getting_in.en: Chengdu, Chongqing, Kunming, Xi'an and Urumqi are emerging as major Chinese hubs.
getting_in.es: Chengdu, Chongqing, Kunming, Xi'an y Urumqi están surgiendo como importantes centros aéreos de China.
getting_in.quote: In particular, Chengdu (CTU IATA & TFU IATA), Chongqing (CKG IATA), Kunming (KMG IATA), Xi'an (XIY IATA) and Urumqi (URC IATA) are emerging as major Chinese hubs

getting_in.en: Airline tickets are expensive or hard to come by around Chinese New Year, the Chinese golden weeks and university holidays.
getting_in.es: Los billetes de avión son caros o difíciles de conseguir en torno al Año Nuevo chino, las semanas doradas chinas y las vacaciones universitarias.
getting_in.quote: Airline tickets are expensive or hard to come by around Chinese New Year, the Chinese golden weeks and university holidays.

getting_in.en: Two daily trains run between Vientiane in Laos and Kunming in China.
getting_in.es: Dos trenes diarios unen Vientián, en Laos, con Kunming, en China.
getting_in.quote: Two daily trains run between Vientiane and Kunming, D87/88 (to Kunming South station) and D83-86 (to Kunming station)

getting_in.en: From Ulaanbaatar there are daily trains to Erenhot, in China.
getting_in.es: Desde Ulán Bator hay trenes diarios a Erenhot, en China.
getting_in.quote: From Ulaanbaatar, there are daily trains to Erenhot (681-686)

getting_around.en: Google Maps does not work in China and has patchy coverage and data quality even when accessed via VPN.
getting_around.es: Google Maps no funciona en China y tiene una cobertura y calidad de datos irregulares incluso con VPN.
getting_around.quote: Google Maps does not work in China, and tends to have patchy coverage and data quality even if accessed via VPN.

getting_around.en: Amap is a very convenient navigation app available for Android and Apple devices.
getting_around.es: Amap es una aplicación de navegación muy cómoda disponible para Android y Apple.
getting_around.quote: Amap (高德地图 gaode ditu) is a very convenient app available for both, Android and Apple devices.

getting_around.en: Flying is particularly useful for getting to or around western China because of the sparse population and more limited high-speed rail network.
getting_around.es: Volar resulta especialmente útil para llegar al oeste de China o desplazarse por él, por su escasa población y su red de alta velocidad más limitada.
getting_around.quote: Flying is particularly useful for getting to or around western China due to the sparse population and more limited high-speed rail network.

getting_around.en: China Railway High-speed is the world's longest high-speed rail network and offers the world's only high-speed sleeper trains.
getting_around.es: El ferrocarril de alta velocidad de China es la red de alta velocidad más larga del mundo y ofrece los únicos trenes cama de alta velocidad del mundo.
getting_around.quote: China Railway High-speed (CRH) is the world's longest network of high-speed railways, and offers the world's only high-speed sleeper trains.

getting_around.en: CTrip is the only way to use an international credit or debit card on the fly to buy train or plane tickets.
getting_around.es: CTrip es la única forma de usar una tarjeta de crédito o débito internacional al momento para comprar billetes de tren o avión.
getting_around.quote: A useful app/website is CTrip, which is the only way you can use an international credit/debit card on the fly to buy train/plane tickets.

getting_around.en: Power banks must have the China Compulsory Certification (CCC or 3C) mark to be brought onto flights.
getting_around.es: Los cargadores portátiles deben llevar la marca de Certificación Obligatoria China (CCC o 3C) para llevarlos en los vuelos.
getting_around.quote: Power banks must have the China Compulsory Certification (CCC or 3C) mark to be brought onto flights.

money.en: The official currency of China is the yuan, known as the renminbi, with the symbol ¥ and currency code CNY.
money.es: La moneda oficial de China es el yuan, conocido como renminbi, con el símbolo ¥ y el código CNY.
money.quote: The official currency of the People's Republic of China is the Chinese yuan, known as the renminbi (人民币 rénmínbì, "People's Money"), denoted by the symbol ¥, international currency code CNY.

money.en: Cashless payments through smartphone apps such as WeChat or Alipay are almost universal.
money.es: Los pagos sin efectivo con aplicaciones móviles como WeChat o Alipay son casi universales.
money.quote: Cashless payments through smartphone apps such as WeChat or Alipay are almost universal.

money.en: Outside major cities, credit cards are not always accepted and ATMs are limited.
money.es: Fuera de las grandes ciudades, no siempre se aceptan tarjetas de crédito y los cajeros son limitados.
money.quote: Outside major cities, credit cards are not always accepted and ATMs are limited.

money.en: Not all businesses accept cash, even if legally required to, and will often not have any change available.
money.es: No todos los comercios aceptan efectivo, aunque la ley los obligue, y a menudo no tienen cambio.
money.quote: Not all businesses accept cash, even if legally required to, and will often not have any change available.

money.en: Counterfeit banknotes, especially 100 renminbi notes, are common, including from ATMs, and banks will not replace them.
money.es: Los billetes falsos, sobre todo de 100 renminbi, son comunes, incluso en cajeros, y los bancos no los sustituyen.
money.quote: Counterfeit banknotes (especially 100 renminbi notes) are common, including from ATMs. Banks will not replace them.

money.en: Foreign currencies are rarely seen as a substitute for yuan except in some five-star hotels.
money.es: Las divisas extranjeras rara vez sustituyen al yuan, salvo en algunos hoteles de cinco estrellas.
money.quote: Foreign currencies, including the Hong Kong dollar or U.S. dollar, are rarely seen as a substitute for yuan except in some five-star hotels

etiquette.en: Greet people with a soft handshake, which can be accompanied by a slight bow.
etiquette.es: Salude con un apretón de manos suave, que puede ir acompañado de una ligera reverencia.
etiquette.quote: Give a soft handshake when greeting someone, which can be accompanied by a slight bow.

etiquette.en: Important items such as business cards or papers are given and received with both hands.
etiquette.es: Los objetos importantes, como las tarjetas de visita o los documentos, se dan y se reciben con ambas manos.
etiquette.quote: Important items such as business cards or important papers are given and received with both hands.

etiquette.en: If your hosts wear slippers at home, especially with carpet, remove your shoes and ask for slippers before entering.
etiquette.es: Si sus anfitriones llevan zapatillas en casa, sobre todo si hay alfombra, quítese los zapatos y pida unas zapatillas antes de entrar.
etiquette.quote: If your hosts are wearing slippers at home, and especially if there is carpet on the floor, remove your shoes and ask for a pair of slippers before you enter

etiquette.en: Saving face is important in Chinese culture, and pointing out mistakes directly may cause embarrassment.
etiquette.es: Mantener las apariencias es importante en la cultura china, y señalar errores directamente puede causar vergüenza.
etiquette.quote: Saving face is an important concept in Chinese culture, and this concept extends beyond the individual to one's family (including extended family), and even the country. Pointing out mistakes directly may cause embarrassment.

etiquette.en: On public transport you are expected to give up your seat for elderly passengers.
etiquette.es: En el transporte público se espera que ceda su asiento a las personas mayores.
etiquette.quote: When riding in public transport, you are expected to give up your seat for elderly passengers

etiquette.en: At temples, do not point at statues of deities with your index finger, as this is very rude.
etiquette.es: En los templos, no señale las estatuas de deidades con el dedo índice, pues es muy grosero.
etiquette.quote: When visiting temples, do not point at the statues of deities with your index finger, as this is very rude.

connectivity.en: The Great Firewall of China blocks popular web services including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, Google, WhatsApp, Telegram and Wikipedia.
connectivity.es: El Gran Cortafuegos de China bloquea servicios populares como Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, Google, WhatsApp, Telegram y Wikipedia.
connectivity.quote: The Great Firewall of China blocks popular web services including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, YouTube, Google, WhatsApp, Telegram and many others including Wikipedia.

connectivity.en: Install a VPN before arriving in China, as attempting to do so after landing can be problematic because the service might already be blocked.
connectivity.es: Instale una VPN antes de llegar a China, ya que intentarlo tras aterrizar puede ser problemático porque el servicio podría estar ya bloqueado.
connectivity.quote: Be sure to install the VPN before arriving in China; attempting to do so after landing can be problematic as the service might already be blocked.

connectivity.en: Another way around censorship is to roam on a non-Mainland Chinese SIM, as mobile data is typically routed through foreign gateways.
connectivity.es: Otra forma de evitar la censura es usar una SIM no china en itinerancia, ya que los datos móviles suelen enrutarse por puertas de enlace extranjeras.
connectivity.quote: Another way is to simply roam on a non-Mainland Chinese SIM as mobile data is typically routed through foreign gateways.

connectivity.en: Only main office branches and airport branches accept foreign passports as identification to obtain a SIM card.
connectivity.es: Solo las oficinas principales y las sucursales de los aeropuertos aceptan pasaportes extranjeros como identificación para obtener una tarjeta SIM.
connectivity.quote: Only main office branches and airport branches will accept foreign passports as identification to obtain a SIM card.

connectivity.en: China's cybersecurity laws state that online products and services, for example VPNs, need to be licensed by the Chinese government.
connectivity.es: Las leyes de ciberseguridad de China establecen que los productos y servicios en línea, por ejemplo las VPN, deben contar con licencia del Gobierno chino.
connectivity.quote: China’s cybersecurity laws state that online products and services (for example, VPNs) need to be licensed by the Chinese government.

connectivity.en: Most public venues in China, such as libraries, restaurants and malls, offer free Wi-Fi access.
connectivity.es: La mayoría de los lugares públicos en China, como bibliotecas, restaurantes y centros comerciales, ofrecen wifi gratuito.
connectivity.quote: Most public venues in China, such as libraries, restaurants and malls, offer free Wi-Fi access.
